gate: PBE plane-wave fixed-cell volume and structural replication
edge_rule: If the lowest energy is at 3.6 or 4.4 A, expand the bracket once in the downhill direction before deciding. A second edge-pinned downhill result kills the registered phase.
kill_triggers: loss of eightfold Pd-H coordination under 2.25 A cutoff
persistent total magnetic moment above 0.10 muB
insulating endpoint on the registered minimum mesh
no interior energy minimum after one bracket expansion
irreproducible or nonconvergent structural endpoint within the registered compute budget
promotion: Only a passing structural/volume gate may proceed to an independent endpoint replication and targeted Pd-H decomposition screen. No phonon or EPC calculation is authorized by this gate.
